narrative: On the plot. The pasteboard plot hangs inside the tiring-house door, and past the door the yard is thin, wet gowns and a great deal of empty ground. On the plot. Rain has darkened the lower edge of the board. The title is still the whole of what it says.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Read the plot at the door and went on.

entities.name: The Comedy of Errors
entities.context: Shown on plot in A thin bill
